description: Stat-led Envoy Gateway detail view. Counterpart to the NGINX / Ingress controller (nextgen) dashboard.

panels.description: Total downstream requests in the selected time range.
panels.title: Requests (period)

panels.description: Downstream request time. The Average series uses Envoy's _sum/_count rather than the bucket-weighted approximation the nginx dashboard needs.
panels.title: Latency (Percentiles)

targets.expr: sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route", envoy_response_code_class!~"4|5"}[${__range_s}s])) by (envoy_cluster_name) / sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[${__range_s}s])) by (envoy_cluster_name)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, envoy_cluster_name))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, envoy_cluster_name))

histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{gateway_namespace=~"$gateway_namespace", gateway=~"$gateway", pod=~"$pod", envoy_cluster_name=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, envoy_cluster_name))
